text: The clinic is clean and the doctor is professional.
The doctor is very lovely, and the assistant is also very lovely. I've been following the doctor for 20 years now, and she's still as lovely and does as good a job as ever.
All the doctors are kind enough to explain any questions before starting treatment.
I saw the doctor today, and she's as lovely as ever.
